# fastText

[fastText](https://fasttext.cc/) is a library for efficient learning of word representations and sentence classification.

## What is fastText?

fastText is a library for efficient text classification and representation learning. It can be used for:

- **Word representation learning**: Learn vector representations of words (word embeddings)
- **Text classification**: Classify text documents into categories (e.g., spam detection, sentiment analysis)
- **Language identification**: Detect the language of text

## Usage

fastText provides a command-line tool with the following main commands:

### Word Representation Learning

Train word vectors using the skipgram model:
```bash
$ ./fasttext skipgram -input data.txt -output model
```

Train word vectors using the cbow model:
```bash
$ ./fasttext cbow -input data.txt -output model
```

### Getting Word Vectors

Print word vectors for words in a file:
```bash
$ ./fasttext print-word-vectors model.bin < queries.txt
```

Get word vectors for out-of-vocabulary words using subword information:
```bash
$ ./fasttext print-word-vectors model.bin
```

### Text Classification

Train a text classifier:
```bash
$ ./fasttext supervised -input train.txt -output model
```

Test the classifier:
```bash
$ ./fasttext test model.bin test.txt
```

Predict labels for new text:
```bash
$ ./fasttext predict model.bin test.txt
```

Predict labels with probabilities:
```bash
$ ./fasttext predict-prob model.bin test.txt
```

### Quantization

Reduce model size with quantization:
```bash
$ ./fasttext quantize -output model
```

This creates a `.ftz` file with reduced memory footprint while maintaining functionality.

## Input Format

### For Supervised Learning (Text Classification)

Training data should be in a text file with one sample per line. Each line should contain labels prefixed with `__label__` followed by the text:

```
__label__positive This movie was great!
__label__negative Terrible experience.
__label__neutral It was okay.
```

### For Unsupervised Learning (Word Vectors)

Training data should be a text file with one sentence per line:

```
This is a sample sentence.
Here is another sentence for training.
Word vectors will be learned from this text.
```

## Command-Line Options

Common options include:

**Dictionary options:**
- `-minCount`: Minimal number of word occurrences (default: 5 for word vectors, 1 for classification)
- `-wordNgrams`: Max length of word n-grams (default: 1)
- `-minn`: Min length of character n-gram (default: 0)
- `-maxn`: Max length of character n-gram (default: 0)
- `-bucket`: Number of buckets (default: 2000000)

**Training options:**
- `-lr`: Learning rate (default: 0.1 for supervised, 0.05 for word vectors)
- `-dim`: Size of word vectors (default: 100)
- `-ws`: Size of context window (default: 5)
- `-epoch`: Number of epochs (default: 5 for supervised, 5 for word vectors)
- `-neg`: Number of negatives sampled (default: 5)
- `-loss`: Loss function - ns (negative sampling), hs (hierarchical softmax), or softmax (default: softmax for supervised, ns for word vectors)
- `-thread`: Number of threads (default: 12)

**Quantization options:**
- `-cutoff`: Number of words and n-grams to retain (default: 0)
- `-retrain`: Whether to fine-tune embeddings if cutoff is applied (default: 0)
- `-qnorm`: Whether to quantize the norm separately (default: 0)
- `-qout`: Whether to quantize the classifier (default: 0)
- `-dsub`: Size of each sub-vector (default: 2)

Run any command without arguments to see its full option list:
```bash
$ ./fasttext supervised
$ ./fasttext skipgram
$ ./fasttext cbow
```

## Pre-trained Models

fastText provides pre-trained models:
- Word vectors for 157 languages trained on Wikipedia and Common Crawl
- English word vectors
- Language identification models
- Various supervised task models

Visit [https://fasttext.cc/](https://fasttext.cc/) for downloads and more information.

## Output Files

After training, fastText creates several files:

- `model.bin`: Full model file (can be used for further training or getting word vectors)
- `model.vec`: Text file containing word vectors (one per line)
- `model.ftz`: Quantized model file (smaller, load-only)

## Examples

### Example 1: Train Word Vectors

```bash
# Train skipgram model on text file
$ ./fasttext skipgram -input data.txt -output model -dim 300 -epoch 5

# Get vectors for specific words
$ echo "king queen man woman" | ./fasttext print-word-vectors model.bin
```

### Example 2: Text Classification

```bash
# Train classifier on labeled data
$ ./fasttext supervised -input train.txt -output model -epoch 25 -lr 1.0

# Test the model
$ ./fasttext test model.bin test.txt

# Predict on new data
$ ./fasttext predict model.bin -
> This is a test sentence
```

### Example 3: Quantization

```bash
# Quantize a model to reduce size
$ ./fasttext quantize -input model.bin -output model

# Use the quantized model (same as regular model)
$ ./fasttext test model.ftz test.txt
```

## Resources

- Website: [https://fasttext.cc/](https://fasttext.cc/)
- Documentation: [https://fasttext.cc/docs/](https://fasttext.cc/docs/)
- Pre-trained models: [https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/pretrained-vectors.html](https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/pretrained-vectors.html)
- Language identification: [https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html](https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html)

## Community

- Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1174547215919768
- Google group: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/fasttext-library

## References

If you use fastText, please cite one of the following papers:

**For word representations:**
- P. Bojanowski, E. Grave, A. Joulin, T. Mikolov, "Enriching Word Vectors with Subword Information"
  Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2017

**For text classification:**
- A. Joulin, E. Grave, P. Bojanowski, T. Mikolov, "Bag of Tricks for Efficient Text Classification"
  Proceedings of the 15th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2017

**For model compression:**
- A. Joulin, E. Grave, P. Bojanowski, M. Douze, H. Jégou, T. Mikolov, "FastText.zip: Compressing text classification models"
  arXiv preprint arXiv:1612.03651, 2016

import struct,sys

off=8
for n in ['dim','ws','epoch','minCount','neg','wordNgrams','loss','model','bucket','minn','maxn','lrUpdateRate']:
    v=struct.unpack('<i',d[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4; print(n,v)
t=struct.unpack('<d',d[off:off+8])[0]; off+=8; print('t',t)

nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
print('size,nw,nl,ntokens,prunesize',size,nw,nl,nt,pn)
words=[]
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    words.append(w)
print('pruneidx off',off)
if pn>0: off+=pn*8
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
print('INPUT',m,n)
for i in range(m):
    vals=struct.unpack('<%df'%n,d[off:off+4*n]); off+=4*n
    print('  ',i,words[i] if i<len(words) else '?', ['%.9g'%x for x in vals])
qout=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m2,n2=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
print('OUTPUT',m2,n2)
for i in range(m2):
    vals=struct.unpack('<%df'%n2,d[off:off+4*n2]); off+=4*n2
    print('  ',i,words[nw+i] if nw+i<len(words) else '?', ['%.9g'%x for x in vals])
print('end',off,len(d))
PYEOF

cat > /tmp/an/raw.py <<'PYEOF'
import struct,sys
d=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
print('len',len(d))
magic,ver=struct.unpack('<Ii',d[:8]); print('magic',hex(magic),'ver',ver)
off=8
for n in ['dim','ws','epoch','minCount','neg','wordNgrams','loss','model','bucket','minn','maxn','lrUpdateRate']:
    v=struct.unpack('<i',d[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4; print(n,v)
t=struct.unpack('<d',d[off:off+8])[0]; off+=8; print('t',t)
size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
print('size,nw,nl,ntokens,prunesize',size,nw,nl,nt,pn)
words=[]
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    words.append(w)
print('pruneidx off',off)
if pn>0: off+=pn*8
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
print('INPUT',m,n)
for i in range(m):
    vals=struct.unpack('<%df'%n,d[off:off+4*n]); off+=4*n
    print('  ',i,words[i] if i<len(words) else '?', ['%.9g'%x for x in vals])
qout=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m2,n2=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
print('OUTPUT',m2,n2)
for i in range(m2):
    vals=struct.unpack('<%df'%n2,d[off:off+4*n2]); off+=4*n2
    print('  ',i,words[nw+i] if nw+i<len(words) else '?', ['%.9g'%x for x in vals])
print('end',off,len(d))
PYEOF
cd /tmp/t3 && python3 /tmp/an/raw.py m.bin; echo "=== dumps"; /workspace/executable dump m.bin input; echo ---; /workspace/executable dump m.bin output

q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
W=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]); off+=4*m*n

qout=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m2,n2=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
O=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m2*n2),d[off:off+4*m2*n2]); off+=4*m2*n2
O=[O[i*n2:(i+1)*n2] for i in range(m2)]

cat > /tmp/an/pred.py <<'PYEOF'
import struct,sys,math
d=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
off=8
for i in range(12): off+=4
off+=8
size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
words=[]
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    words.append((w,ty,cnt))
if pn>0: off+=pn*8
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
W=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]); off+=4*m*n
W=[W[i*n:(i+1)*n] for i in range(m)]
qout=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m2,n2=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
O=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m2*n2),d[off:off+4*m2*n2]); off+=4*m2*n2
O=[O[i*n2:(i+1)*n2] for i in range(m2)]
print('sizes',len(W),len(O),n)
def softmax(h):
    z=[sum(o[j]*h[j] for j in range(n)) for o in O]
    mx=max(z)
    e=[math.exp(x-mx) for x in z]
    s=sum(e)
    return [x/s for x in e]
import itertools
# parse query file
for line in open(sys.argv[2]):
    toks=line.split()
    ws=[t for t in toks if not t.startswith('__label__')]
    idx=[]
    for t in ws+['</s>']:
        for i,(w,ty,c) in enumerate(words):
            if ty==0 and w==t: idx.append(i); break
    h=[sum(W[i][j] for i in idx)/len(idx) for j in range(n)]
    p=softmax(h)
    print([ (words[nw+k][0],round(p[k],6)) for k in range(len(p))])

{"command": "cat > /tmp/an/mkmodel.py <<'PYEOF'
import struct,sys,math
def build(path, words, labels, dim, Win, Wout, ntokens=None):
    nwords=len(words); nlabels=len(labels)
    size=nwords+nlabels
    if ntokens is None: ntokens=nwords*3
    d=bytearray()
    d+=struct.pack('<Ii', 0x2f4f16ba, 12)
    for v in [dim,5,5,1,5,1,3,3,0,0,0,100]: d+=struct.pack('<i',v)
    d+=struct.pack('<d',0.0001)
    d+=struct.pack('<iii',size,nwords,nlabels)
    d+=struct.pack('<qq',ntokens,-1)
    for w in words: d+=w.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('<q',1)+b'\x00'
    for w in labels: d+=w.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('<q',1)+b'\x01'
    d+=b'\x00'  # quant
    m=len(Win); n=dim
    d+=struct.pack('<qq',m,n)
    for row in Win: d+=struct.pack('<%df'%n,*row)
    d+=b'\x00'  # qout
    m2=len(Wout); 
    d+=struct.pack('<qq',m2,n)
    for row in Wout: d+=struct.pack('<%df'%n,*row)
    open(path,'wb').write(d)
    return d
PYEOF
cd /tmp/t3 && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/an')
from mkmodel import build
words=['a','b','</s>']
labels=['__label__A','__label__B']
dim=3
Win=[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]]
Wout=[[1,2,3],[-1,0.5,0.25]]
build('syn.bin',words,labels,dim,Win,Wout)
" && python3 /tmp/an/raw.py syn.bin | tail -8 && printf 'a\nb\n</s>\nzzz\n' > qsyn.txt && /workspace/executable predict-prob syn.bin qsyn.txt"}

actions.command:
cd /tmp/t3 && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import struct
d=open('w10m.bin','rb').read()
# find offset of input matrix
off=8
for i in range(12): off+=4
off+=8
size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
words=[]
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    words.append((w,ty,cnt))
off+=pn*8 if pn>0 else 0
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
print('matrix at',off,'m,n',m,n,'bytes',m*n*4)
data=d[off:off+m*n*4]
print('raw bytes hex:')
import binascii
print(binascii.hexlify(data).decode())
print('as int32:', struct.unpack('<%di'%(m*n), data))
PYEOF

{"command": "cd /tmp/t3 && for d in 2 3 5; do /workspace/executable supervised -input n2.txt -output sc -thread 1 -dim $d -epoch 1 -lr 0 -minn 2 -maxn 3 -bucket 100 -verbose 0 2>&1|tail -1; python3 -c "
import struct
d=open('sc.bin','rb').read()
off=8
for i in range(12): off+=4
off+=8
size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
words=[]
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z]; off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    words.append(w)
if pn>0: off+=pn*8
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
vals=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n])
lim=1.0/$d
# find the last index with |v| <= lim and > 0
last=-1
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    if abs(v)<=lim+1e-9 and abs(v)>1e-9: last=i
print('dim=$d m=%d n=%d total=%d last_nonzero_in_range_idx=%d -> rows=%d'%(m,n,m*n,last,(last//n)+1 if last>=0 else 0))
"; done"}

import struct
for fn in ['sg0.bin','cb0.bin']:
    d=open(fn,'rb').read()
    off=8
    for i in range(12): off+=4
    off+=8
    size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
    nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    for i in range(size):
        z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z]; off=z+1
        cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    if pn>0: off+=pn*8
    q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
    m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    vals=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n])
    nz=sum(1 for v in vals if v!=0)

    print('  first 6:', ['%.6g'%v for v in vals[:6]])
    print('  around 1e6:', ['%.6g'%v for v in vals[1000000:1000006]])
    print('  last 6:', ['%.6g'%v for v in vals[-6:]])
"

{"command": "cat > /tmp/an/cmpvec.py <<'PYEOF'
import struct,sys
base=sys.argv[1]
def parse(fn):
    d=open(fn,'rb').read()
    off=8
    for i in range(12): off+=4
    off+=8
    size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
    nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    words=[]
    for i in range(size):
        z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
        cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
        words.append(w)
    if pn>0: off+=pn*8
    q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
    m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    W=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]); off+=4*m*n
    qout=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
    m2,n2=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    O=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m2*n2),d[off:off+4*m2*n2]); off+=4*m2*n2
    return words,nw,nl,m,n,W,m2,n2,O
words,nw,nl,m,n,W,m2,n2,O=parse(base+'.bin')
lines=open(base+'.vec').read().split('\n')
print('header:',lines[0], ' nwords=%d nw=%d'%(len([l for l in lines[1:] if l.strip()]),nw))
for i,l in enumerate(lines[1:]):
    if not l.strip(): continue
    parts=l.split()
    w=parts[0]; vv=[float(x) for x in parts[1:]]
    if w in words:
        idx=words.index(w)
        iv=[W[idx*n+j] for j in range(n)]
        ov=[O[idx*n2+j] for j in range(n2)] if idx<m2 else None
        same_i = all(abs(vv[j]-iv[j])<1e-6*max(1,abs(iv[j])) for j in range(n))
        same_o = ov is not None and all(abs(vv[j]-ov[j])<1e-6*max(1,abs(ov[j])) for j in range(n))
        print('%s idx=%d matchIN=%s matchOUT=%s'%(w,idx,same_i,same_o))
    else:
        print('%s idx=MISSING'%w)
    if i>6: break
PYEOF

{"command": "cd /tmp/t2 && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import struct
d=open('skbig.bin','rb').read()
off=8
for i in range(12): off+=4
off+=8
size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
words=[]
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    words.append(w)
if pn>0: off+=pn*8
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
W=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]); off+=4*m*n
vec=[l.split() for l in open('skbig.vec').read().split('\n')[1:] if l.strip()]
tgt=[float(x) for x in vec[1][1:]]
print('target (over):', ' '.join('%.6g'%x for x in tgt[:4]))
best=None
for j in range(m):
    row=[W[j*n+k] for k in range(4)]
    if all(abs(row[k]-tgt[k])<1e-6 for k in range(4)):
        print('MATCH at row',j, words[j] if j<len(words) else '?')
# try average of base+subwords
def fnv(s):
    h=2166136261
    for c in s.encode('utf-8'):
        h ^= (c-256 if c>=128 else c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h=(h*16777619)&0xFFFFFFFF
    return h
for w in ['over']:
    wb=('<'+w+'>').encode()
    sw=[]
    for i in range(len(wb)):
        if (wb[i]&0xC0)==0x80: continue
        j=i; ng=1; ng_str=b''
        while j<len(wb) and ng<=6:
            ng_str+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            while j<len(wb) and (wb[j]&0xC0)==0x80: ng_str+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            if ng>=3 and not (ng==1 and (i==0 or j==len(wb))):
                sw.append(nw + fnv(ng_str.decode('latin1'))%2000000)
            ng+=1
    s=[0.0]*n
    for r in sw:
        for k in range(n): s[k]+=W[r*n+k]
    idx=words.index(w)
    base=[W[idx*n+k] for k in range(n)]
    for name,tot in [('avg(base+sw)',[ (base[k]+s[k])/(1+len(sw)) for k in range(n)]),('avg(sw)',[s[k]/len(sw) for k in range(n)]),('base-sw',[base[k]-s[k] for k in range(n)])]:
        print(name,' '.join('%.6g'%x for x in tot[:4]))
PYEOF"}

actions.command:
cd /tmp/t2 && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import struct
d=open('skbig.bin','rb').read()
off=8
for i in range(12): off+=4
off+=8
size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
words=[]
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
    words.append(w)
if pn>0: off+=pn*8
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
W=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]); off+=4*m*n
vec=[l.split() for l in open('skbig.vec').read().split('\n')[1:] if l.strip()]
tgt=[float(x) for x in vec[1][1:]]
print('target (over):', ' '.join('%.6g'%x for x in tgt[:4]))
best=None
for j in range(m):
    row=[W[j*n+k] for k in range(4)]
    if all(abs(row[k]-tgt[k])<1e-6 for k in range(4)):
        print('MATCH at row',j, words[j] if j<len(words) else '?')
# try average of base+subwords
def fnv(s):
    h=2166136261
    for c in s.encode('utf-8'):
        h ^= (c-256 if c>=128 else c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h=(h*16777619)&0xFFFFFFFF
    return h
for w in ['over']:
    wb=('<'+w+'>').encode()
    sw=[]
    for i in range(len(wb)):
        if (wb[i]&0xC0)==0x80: continue
        j=i; ng=1; ng_str=b''
        while j<len(wb) and ng<=6:
            ng_str+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            while j<len(wb) and (wb[j]&0xC0)==0x80: ng_str+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            if ng>=3 and not (ng==1 and (i==0 or j==len(wb))):
                sw.append(nw + fnv(ng_str.decode('latin1'))%2000000)
            ng+=1
    s=[0.0]*n
    for r in sw:
        for k in range(n): s[k]+=W[r*n+k]
    idx=words.index(w)
    base=[W[idx*n+k] for k in range(n)]
    for name,tot in [('avg(base+sw)',[ (base[k]+s[k])/(1+len(sw)) for k in range(n)]),('avg(sw)',[s[k]/len(sw) for k in range(n)]),('base-sw',[base[k]-s[k] for k in range(n)])]:
        print(name,' '.join('%.6g'%x for x in tot[:4]))
PYEOF

{"command": "cd /tmp/t3 && for cfg in "-minn 0 -maxn 0" "-minn 3 -maxn 6" "-wordNgrams 2"; do /workspace/executable skipgram -input s1.txt -output sk6 -thread 1 -dim 5 -epoch 1 -lr 0 -ws 1 -neg 1 $cfg -bucket 100 -minCount 1 -verbose 0 2>&1|tail -1; python3 -c "
import struct
d=open('sk6.bin','rb').read()
off=8
for i in range(12): off+=4
off+=8
size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
for i in range(size):
    z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z]; off=z+1
    cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
if pn>0: off+=pn*8
q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
nz=sum(1 for v in struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]) if v!=0)
print('  cfg=$cfg m=%d n=%d nz=%d'%(m,n,nz))
"; done"}

{"command": "cat > /tmp/an/dictparse.py <<'PYEOF'
import struct,sys
def parse(fn):
    d=open(fn,'rb').read()
    off=8
    for i in range(12): off+=4
    off+=8
    size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
    nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    entries=[]
    for i in range(size):
        z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
        cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
        entries.append({'word':w,'count':cnt,'type':ty})
    if pn>0: off+=pn*8
    q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
    m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    W=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]); off+=4*m*n
    W=[W[i*n:(i+1)*n] for i in range(m)]
    qout=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
    m2,n2=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    O=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m2*n2),d[off:off+4*m2*n2]); off+=4*m2*n2
    O=[O[i*n2:(i+1)*n2] for i in range(m2)]
    args={}
    off2=8
    for name in ['dim','ws','epoch','minCount','neg','wordNgrams','loss','model','bucket','minn','maxn','lrUpdateRate']:
        args[name]=struct.unpack('<i',d[off2:off2+4])[0]; off2+=4
    args['t']=struct.unpack('<d',d[off2:off2+8])[0]
    return {'args':args,'size':size,'nwords':nw,'nlabels':nl,'ntokens':nt,'entries':entries,'W':W,'O':O,'m':m,'n':n,'m2':m2,'n2':n2}
def fnv(s):
    h=2166136261
    for c in s.encode('utf-8'):
        h ^= ((c-256) if c>=128 else c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h=(h*16777619)&0xFFFFFFFF
    return h
def subwords(word, minn, maxn, bucket):
    wb=('<'+word+'>').encode('utf-8')
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(wb)):
        if (wb[i]&0xC0)==0x80: continue
        j=i; ng=1; s=b''
        while j<len(wb) and ng<=maxn:
            s+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            while j<len(wb) and (wb[j]&0xC0)==0x80: s+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            if ng>=minn and not (ng==1 and (i==0 or j==len(wb))):
                out.append((s.decode('latin1'), fnv(s.decode('latin1'))%bucket))
            ng+=1
    return out
PYEOF

nw=d['nwords']; bucket=d['args']['bucket']
for i,e in enumerate(d['entries']):
    print(i,repr(e['word']),d['W'][i])
for w in ['alpha','</s>']:
    sw=subwords(w,d['args']['minn'],d['args']['maxn'],bucket)
    print('subwords of',repr(w),sw)
    print('  rows:',[(nw+h, ['%.6g'%v for v in d['W'][nw+h]]) for s,h in sw])

import struct,sys
def parse(fn):
    d=open(fn,'rb').read()
    off=8
    for i in range(12): off+=4
    off+=8
    size,nw,nl=struct.unpack('<iii',d[off:off+12]); off+=12
    nt,pn=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    entries=[]
    for i in range(size):
        z=d.index(b'\0',off); w=d[off:z].decode(); off=z+1
        cnt,ty=struct.unpack('<qb',d[off:off+9]); off+=9
        entries.append({'word':w,'count':cnt,'type':ty})
    if pn>0: off+=pn*8
    q=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
    m,n=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    W=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m*n),d[off:off+4*m*n]); off+=4*m*n
    W=[W[i*n:(i+1)*n] for i in range(m)]
    qout=struct.unpack('<B',d[off:off+1])[0]; off+=1
    m2,n2=struct.unpack('<qq',d[off:off+16]); off+=16
    O=struct.unpack('<%df'%(m2*n2),d[off:off+4*m2*n2]); off+=4*m2*n2
    O=[O[i*n2:(i+1)*n2] for i in range(m2)]
    args={}
    off2=8
    for name in ['dim','ws','epoch','minCount','neg','wordNgrams','loss','model','bucket','minn','maxn','lrUpdateRate']:
        args[name]=struct.unpack('<i',d[off2:off2+4])[0]; off2+=4
    args['t']=struct.unpack('<d',d[off2:off2+8])[0]
    return {'args':args,'size':size,'nwords':nw,'nlabels':nl,'ntokens':nt,'entries':entries,'W':W,'O':O,'m':m,'n':n,'m2':m2,'n2':n2}
def fnv(s):
    h=2166136261
    for c in s.encode('utf-8'):
        h ^= ((c-256) if c>=128 else c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h=(h*16777619)&0xFFFFFFFF
    return h
def subwords(word, minn, maxn, bucket):
    wb=('<'+word+'>').encode('utf-8')
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(wb)):
        if (wb[i]&0xC0)==0x80: continue
        j=i; ng=1; s=b''
        while j<len(wb) and ng<=maxn:
            s+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            while j<len(wb) and (wb[j]&0xC0)==0x80: s+=wb[j:j+1]; j+=1
            if ng>=minn and not (ng==1 and (i==0 or j==len(wb))):
                out.append((s.decode('latin1'), fnv(s.decode('latin1'))%bucket))
            ng+=1
    return out
PYEOF

for w in ['alpha','</s>']:
    sw=subwords(w,d['args']['minn'],d['args']['maxn'],bucket)
    print('subwords of',repr(w),sw)

PYEOF

int32 magic = 0x2f4f16ba, int32 version = 12, then
dim,ws,epoch,minCount,neg,wordNgrams,loss,model,bucket,minn,maxn,lrUpdateRate (int32 each),
